content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face a critical barrier: international payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This leaves you unable to sell your digital products—[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide-5|How to]], courses, templates—to a global audience. The solution isn’t a workaround; it’s sovereign commerce infrastructure. COREMERCH provides the tools to deploy your own store, own your data, and process payments directly through blockchain. No platform dependencies. No subscriptions. Full ownership. This guide walks you through every step to launch your store, from payment pipelines to file delivery, using tools like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-every-detail-3|cloudflare]], Supabase, and NOWPayments. By the end, you’ll have a fully operational, sovereign commerce stack that works anywhere—even in regions where traditional platforms fail.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Kenyan creators

Traditional payment platforms fail creators in Kenya because they rely on centralized systems that exclude entire regions. COREMERCH’s infrastructure replaces these systems with decentralized tools. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store for free, while Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic without servers. Supabase stores orders securely, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files instantly. NOWPayments processes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-5|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. This stack removes geographic barriers entirely. You’re not renting infrastructure—you’re owning it. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your store. It’s yours to control, scale, and monetize globally. This isn’t a patch; it’s a permanent solution built for creators who need sovereignty, not workarounds.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather your digital products, a domain name (optional but recommended), and a crypto wallet to receive payments. Choose a low-fee blockchain network like BSC, Solana, or TRON for transactions under $0.10. Sign up for NOWPayments to generate payment APIs. If using The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), you’ll get full documentation and source code to deploy Stack 01 or Stack 02. No coding required—just follow the step-by-step guides. Ensure your products are ready for upload to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your payment pipeline by sending a small transaction to your wallet. Once confirmed, you’re ready to deploy. This preparation ensures your store launches smoothly, with all components integrated and functional from day one.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept payments in your chosen cryptocurrencies. Set up webhooks to trigger file delivery once payment confirms on-chain. For file delivery, upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and generate shareable links. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery process. When a payment is verified, the script sends the file link to the buyer’s email. Store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets for tracking. Test the pipeline by simulating a purchase. Ensure the payment triggers the webhook, the script delivers the file, and the order is logged. This pipeline is the backbone of your store—reliable, automatic, and fully under your control.
Own your commerce infrastructure—no platform dependencies, no subscriptions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for free hosting. Connect your domain for a professional look. Once live, share your store link with your audience. When a buyer purchases a product, NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and triggers the webhook. Your backend script delivers the file and logs the order. Monitor your crypto wallet and Supabase dashboard to confirm the transaction. Respond to any buyer inquiries promptly. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works. From here, focus on marketing and scaling. You now have a fully operational store that processes payments and delivers products automatically, without relying on third-party platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, scale by adding more products, optimizing your marketing, and expanding your audience. Use Supabase to analyze order data and identify top-selling products. Add email marketing integrations to build a subscriber list. If traffic increases, upgrade to Cloudflare’s paid plans for higher capacity. For advanced users, The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes a scaling playbook with strategies for growth. Reinvest profits into advertising or new product development. Your infrastructure is designed to handle growth without additional platform fees. Focus on creating value for your customers, knowing your commerce stack is secure, sovereign, and ready for global scale.

2. Sign up for NOWPayments and choose a low-fee blockchain network.

4. Configure webhooks in NOWPayments to trigger file delivery.
